info.title: mdtox
info.description: Convert Markdown into professional PDF, DOCX, HTML, and PPTX documents with themes, TOC, cover pages, Mermaid diagrams, and more.

commands.name: render-svg
commands.description: Convert SVG to raster image (PNG, JPEG, WebP)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output file path (default: input name + format extension)
Supported formats: pdf, html, docx, pptx

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format (pdf, html, docx, pptx) — overrides extension

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write output to stdout (for piping). Cannot combine with --json.

options.name: --page-numbers
options.description: Include page numbers in PDF footer

options.name: --theme
options.description:
Apply a visual theme. Accepts:
- Built-in name (corporate, technical, etc.)
- JSON file path (.theme.json)
- YAML file path (.theme.yaml, .theme.yml)
--extract-theme Extract theme from a .docx template to JSON

options.name: --list-themes
options.description:
List all available themes and exit
--theme-catalog Generate a PDF catalog previewing all available themes
--h1-is-heading Keep the first H1 as Heading1 instead of promoting to Title

options.name: --template
options.description:
Templates use {{tokenName}} placeholders that are replaced during conversion. Tokens can appear in body, headers, footers, table cells, and text-boxes. Token values are sourced from (in priority order): 1. YAML frontmatter scalars (non-reserved keys) 2. ::: token ... ::: rich-content blocks in Markdown 3. Remaining body content → implicit {{CONTENT}} token Use inspect_docx_template (MCP) or open the .docx to see which tokens a template expects. Extended Callouts & Highlight (GFM alerts + Obsidian-compatible syntax): MdToX accepts GitHub Flavored Markdown alerts plus the extended admonition set popularized by Obsidian, and ==highlighted text== (Pandoc/CriticMarkup), on every output format (HTML, PDF, DOCX, PPTX). > [!tip] Optional Title > Body lines stay quoted. > > > [!warning] Nested callout Foldables (HTML only): `> [!type]-` collapsed, `> [!type]+` expanded. Types (with aliases): note, abstract/summary/tldr, info, todo, tip/hint/important, success/check/done, question/help/faq, warning/caution/attention, failure/fail/missing, danger/error, bug, example, quote/cite. Unknown types render with a neutral fallback style and emit a structured warning. Inline `==highlight==` works anywhere; composes with **bold**/*italic*. Per-format fidelity (icons, foldables, nesting): see the README "Per-format Fidelity" matrix. Trademark note: "Obsidian" is a trademark of Dynalist Inc. MdToX is not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian. Diff Code Blocks: A fenced ```diff block is colored per line by its leading marker, on every output format (HTML, PDF, DOCX, PPTX): ```diff + added line (green text on a tinted background) - removed line (red) context line (unchanged) @@ hunk header @@ (attenuated meta color) ``` Colors come from theme tokens, overridable in a .theme.yaml: diff-add-color, diff-add-background, diff-remove-color, diff-remove-background, diff-meta-color. The built-in `dark` theme ships darker, legible variants. PDF/Print Page-Break Protection: In @media print (PDF output), oversize content is kept whole: - .mermaid-diagram, .html-embed, code, table, blockquote, .callout use break-inside: avoid so they are not split across pages. - .mermaid-diagram, .html-embed, and img are capped at max-height: 92vh with object-fit: contain — a diagram or image taller than an A4 page is scaled to fit on one page. Opt out per element by wrapping it in
…
(raw HTML in Markdown). The class restores break-inside: auto and removes the height cap; the cascade reaches descendants. Use it when content genuinely needs to span pages (long sequential diagrams, multi-page tables). Image Options (DOCX only):

disabled: images are not embedded

Download remote images without interactive consent

Output:

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version
YAML Frontmatter:
All conversion options can be set via YAML frontmatter in the Markdown file.
CLI flags take precedence when both are specified. Supported keys:
format, output, theme, toc, cover, author, date, title,
page-numbers, landscape, mermaid, images, allow-remote-images,
template, h1-is-heading
Any non-reserved YAML scalar becomes a template token value.

When input is .docx, reverse-converts to Markdown
